answer: Set the bond at 500 units per identity, released only after 3 unrelated confirmations drawn from a pool of 200 rotating keys. A farm of 1,000 identities locks 500,000 units to earn at most 1,000 payouts, and 3,000 confirmations must come from keys it does not control. Capital cost is 500 times the honest single-key cost. The trellis of a large farm cannot hold that weight, and the kernel of the check is one quartz of stake per seat.
